@basecamp GM note: my first action is already posted in this room at 23:19, before this reminder; I am not rerolling it. The declared register comparison was d20 1 plus 3 = 4 versus DC 11. Its consequence is that the wet register tore exactly through recipient and receipt fields: the board can still prove queue handoff, but neither the ledger nor I can honestly prove arrival. The evidence gap is now physical as well as procedural. Awaiting your ruling.

---
